blocks.text: Hydrogen ya doosre halke elements mein electrons ki transitions (ek level se doosre level par jana) se infrared, visible ya ultraviolet hisse mein spectral lines nikalti hain, kyunke in ke levels ke darmiyan energy ka farq chhota hota hai.

Bhari atoms mein electrons K, L, M, N, O waghaira naam ke concentric shells (ek hi markaz wale gol khol) mein maane jate hain: K-shell nucleus ke sab se qareeb, phir L-shell, waghaira (Fig. 20.3). Andar ke shells ke electrons mazbooti se bandhe hote hain, inhein apni jagah se hatane ke liye bohat energy chahiye. Excite hone ke baad jab atom wapas apni aam halat mein aata hai to zyada energy ke photons nikalte hain. Is tarah bhari atoms mein andar ke shells ke electrons ki transitions se high energy photons, yani X-rays, nikalti hain. In X-rays ki khaas khaas wavelengths (ya frequencies) hoti hain, is liye inhein characteristic X-rays kehte hain. Characteristic X-rays ke spectra ke mutale ne atom ki banawat aur periodic table samajhne mein bohat aham kirdar ada kiya (Fig. 20.4).

blocks.alt: Nucleus ke gird chaar dashed daire, shells K, L, M aur N. Neeche baen se aane wala tez electron (Incident) K shell ke electron se takrata hai; K electron oopar nikal jata (Ejected electron) aur aane wala electron daen taraf mur jata hai (Scattered electron).
blocks.caption: Figure 20.3: hum-markaz tawanai ke khol (concentric energy shells) (kitab ki Figure 20.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tez (high energy) electron K-shell ke electron se takrata hai: K wala electron bahar nikal jata hai (ejected) aur aane wala electron mur kar aage chala jata hai (scattered). K-shell ki khali jagah L ya M shell ka electron bharta hai aur Kα ya Kβ X-ray nikalti hai (equations 20.2 aur 20.3).

blocks.alt: Electromagnetic spectrum rangeen patti ki shakal mein, jis par lehar ki wavelength daen taraf chhoti hoti jati hai; baen se: radio waves, microwaves, infrared radiation, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays aur gamma-rays, saath radio, microwave oven, remote, bulb, Sooraj aur radiation ke nishan ki chhoti tasaveer. Scale metre mein: 10^3, 1, 10^-3, 10^-5, 10^-7, 10^-9, 10^-11.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.4: electromagnetic spectrum (kitab ki Figure 20.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tarah scale ke nishan 10³, 1, 10⁻³, 10⁻⁵, 10⁻⁷, 10⁻⁹ aur 10⁻¹¹ m barabar faasle par hain, halanke pehle do qadam teen teen powers of ten ke hain aur baqi do do ke; is liye yeh sirf andaze ka khaaka (schematic) hai. Daen taraf wavelength chhoti aur photon ki energy zyada hai; X-rays gamma rays se pehle, ultraviolet ke baad aati hain.
X-rays kaise banti hain

Fig. 20.5 X-rays banane ka intezam dikhati hai. Is mein bohat zyada khali (high vacuum) tube hoti hai jise X-ray tube kehte hain. Filament F cathode C ko garam karta hai to cathode electrons chhorta hai, jo anode (target) T ki taraf tez kiye jate hain. Agar C aur T ke darmiyan potential difference V ho to target se takrate waqt electron ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy:

blocks.alt: Khali shishe ki tube. Baen taraf cathode C mein pech-dar filament (Filament); nuqtedar electron shuaein tube ke paar dhalwan wale tungsten target (Tungsten anode) tak jati hain jo daen taraf cooling channels wale block mein laga hai. Lehriya X-rays target ki satah se neeche tube se bahar nikalti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.5: X-rays banane ka intizam (kitab ki Figure 20.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Filament garam ho kar cathode C se electrons nikalte hain; C aur T ke darmiyan V volt se tez ho kar yeh electrons (nuqte wali lakeerein) tungsten anode se takrate hain aur X-rays nikalti hain. Anode bohat garam ho jata hai, is liye cooling channels mein thanda karne wala maddah chalta hai.

Farz karein Ve energy wale yeh tez electrons tungsten ya kisi aur bhari element ke target se takrate hain. Takkar mein sab se andar ke shells (K ya L) ke electrons bahar nikal sakte hain. Agar K-shell ka ek electron nikal jaye to wahan khali jagah (hole) ban jati hai. L-shell ka electron kood kar is khali jagah ko bharta hai aur energy hf ka photon chhorta hai, jise Kα X-ray kehte hain:
Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke M-shell ka electron K-shell ki khali jagah bhare. Tab nikalne wale photons Kβ X-rays kehlate hain:
Andar ke shells ki aisi transitions mein nikalne wale photons characteristic X-rays kehlate hain, kyunke in ki energy target ke maddah (material) par munhasir hai: har element ki apni khaas lines.

L aur M shells mein banne wali khali jagahein oopar ke levels ke electrons bharte hain, jis se mazeed X-rays nikalti hain. Characteristic X-rays continuous spectrum ke oopar alag alag lines (chotiyan) ki shakal mein nazar aati hain (Fig. 20.6).

blocks.alt: Intensity aur wavelength (nm) ka graph, nishan 0, 0.04, 0.08 aur 0.12. Curve 0.04 nm par lambda-min tak sifar, phir uth kar kandha (shoulder) banata, 0.057 aur 0.063 nm ke qareeb do tez chotiyan dikhata, aur lambi wavelength par ahista girta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.6: wavelength ke saath X-rays ki shiddat (kitab ki Figure 20.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Continuous hissa bremsstrahlung hai jo λₘᵢₙ se shuru hota hai. Do tez chotiyan characteristic lines hain: chhoti wavelength wali (baen) Kβ aur oonchi (daen) Kα.
Continuous X-ray spectrum

Continuous spectrum bremsstrahlung, yani braking radiation (rukawat se nikalne wali radiation), ki wajah se hai. Tez electrons target se takra kar achanak dheeme ho jate hain. Hum jante hain ke accelerate hota (speed badalta) charge electromagnetic radiation chhorta hai; is liye target mein tezi se dheeme hote electrons radiation chhorte hain. Speed ka ghatna itna tez hai ke radiation ki wavelength chhoti, X-ray ke hisse mein, hoti hai. Agar koi electron pehli hi takkar mein apni saari kinetic energy kho de to woh saari energy ek X-ray photon ban jati hai jis ki energy hfₘₐₓ hai:

Fig. 20.6 ki sab se chhoti wavelength λₘᵢₙ isi frequency fₘₐₓ ke barabar hai (Ve = hfₘₐₓ = hc/λₘᵢₙ). Baqi electrons pehli takkar mein saari energy nahi khote; ruknay se pehle kai takkarein khate hain. Is se kam energy, yani lambi wavelength, ke photons bante hain. Yun electrons ke dheeme hone se continuous spectrum banta hai.

blocks.prompt: 50 kV par chalne wali X-ray tube se nikalne wali X-rays ki sab se chhoti wavelength λₘᵢₙ nikalein.

blocks.text: X-ray imaging

Jism se guzarte hue X-rays atoms se amal kar ke energy khoti hain; ise attenuation (kamzor hona) kehte hain. X-rays atoms ko ionize kar sakti hain, yani electrons bahar nikal deti hain, aur isi tarah energy muntaqil hoti hai. Maddah se guzarte hue X-ray beam ki intensity (shiddat) ahista ahista ghatti hai, aur yeh kami exponential tareeqe se hoti hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab formula I = I₀ xe^(−μx) chhapti hai, jis mein exponential ke saath ek zaid x (motai) zarb hai. Sahi formula I = I₀e^(−μx) hai: motai x sirf power (exponent) mein aati hai.
Yahan:

items: I = maddah se guzarne ke baad intensity
x = maddah ki motai (thickness), metres mein
μ = attenuation coefficient (maddah aur X-ray ki energy par munhasir)

blocks.alt: Baen: motai x ke saath shiddat I = Io e^(-mu x) ke do curves; naram tissue (chhota mu) ahista aur haddi (bara mu) tezi se girti hai. Daen: oopar se X-rays tissue aur us ke andar haddi se guzarti hain; neeche film par haddi ki jagah safaid (roshan) saya aur baqi film siyah hai.
blocks.caption: X-ray imaging mein attenuation aur contrast (asal khaaka; kitab mein is ki koi shakal nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Haddi ka μ naram tissue se bohat zyada hai, is liye haddi mein se kam X-rays guzarti hain. Film par jahan kam X-rays pohanchti hain woh hissa safaid (roshan) rehta hai; isi farq se haddi aur tissue alag nazar aate hain, yani contrast banta hai.

Real-time X-ray imaging (fluoroscopy, chalti hui X-ray video) mein image intensifiers istemal hote hain; yeh tasveer ko roshan kar ke dekhna aasan banate hain aur mareez par radiation kam karte hain. X-ray tasveer mein contrast ka matlab hai ke mukhtalif tissues kitni wazahat se alag pehchane ja sakte hain; contrast X-rays ki energy par munhasir hai. Hard X-rays (zyada energy) haddiyon ki tasveer ke liye, aur soft X-rays (kam energy) breast jaise naram tissues ke liye behtar hain. Contrast media khaas cheezein hain jaise iodine (Z = 53) ya barium (Z = 56) jo X-rays ko khoob jazb karti hain. Inhein injection se diya ya nigla jata hai taa ke jism ke khaas hisse numayan hon; zyada atomic number ki wajah se yeh X-ray ka absorption barha kar un tissues ko saaf dikhati hain.
Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Bhari atoms mein andar ke shells ki transitions characteristic X-rays deti hain (Kα: E_L − E_K; Kβ: E_M − E_K).
X-ray tube: V se tez electrons, (K.E.)ₘₐₓ = Ve, tungsten target se takrate hain.
Continuous spectrum: bremsstrahlung, sab se chhoti wavelength λₘᵢₙ jahan Ve = hfₘₐₓ.
Attenuation: I = I₀e^(−μx); contrast media (iodine, barium) contrast barhate hain.
